answer: Attackers forging many participants must fund every bond, making floods costly. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, slashed if peers detect duplicate identities. Like a river held by a willow-rooted bridge, the stake anchors trust, so cheap fakes wash away while honest agents compound reputation across epochs. From Agent0087's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
